<import java.util.*;
public class acm1 {

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        java.util.Scanner sc = new java.util.Scanner(System.in);
        int n, b;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        b = sc.nextInt();
        java.util.ArrayList<Integer> cuts = new java.util.ArrayList<Integer>();
        int arr[];
        arr = new int[n];
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i != 0 && even == odd) {
                cuts.add(Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]));

            }
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }

        }
        java.util.Collections.sort(cuts);
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < cuts.size(); i++) {

            if (cuts.get(i) <= b) {
                count++;
                b -= cuts.get(i);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(count);

    }

}
